title: クレーンゲームに挑戦！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Inari One…

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Hey, lookie there! That's those Cuties everyone's ravin' about.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I look in the direction Inari One is pointing and see a claw machine filled with Umamusume plushies.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: They all look so adorable. I jus' wanna scoop 'em all up.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Not too good with this kinda game though, sadly. When it comes to festival fishin' games, I can reel prizes in all day!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Oh-ho! I like your spirit, Boss! You're confident, huh?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Oh-ho! I like your spirit, Boss! You're confident, huh?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Then let's see what ya got. Don't let me down!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's no way I can fail now!
